newsitem.title: USA: US Wats names new president and CEO.
newsitem.headline: US Wats names new president and CEO.

text.p: US WATS Inc said Thursday it had named Kevin O'Hare, a former executive vice president of C-TEC, as its president and chief executive.
O'Hare's experience in telecommunications and long-distance also includes serving in a management capacity for ACC Long Distance Corp and managing telephone companies for Frontier Corp, US Wats said.
O'Hare succeeds Aaron Brown as chief executive.
Brown said he HAD BECOME chairman, succeeding Stephen Parker, who is now vice chairman.
Brown said O'Hare succeeds Mark Scully as president. Scully remains with the company but has no title presently, Brown said.
Brown said US Wats, a switch-based long-distance telephone company, should earning a profit in fiscal 1996 after posting a loss in fiscal 1995.
The company reported a profit of $0.01 a share in each of the first three quarters of 1996.
The company said it had also hired another former C-TEC executive, David Hurwitz, as its new sales and marketing executive vice president.
